items: A mesh file (.glb, .gltf, .obj or .stl) uploaded to the server and placed as one block. Drops a crate first, then swaps in the real mesh when the file has parsed. sx scales it.
A survey point cloud (.xyz, .pts or .ply) drawn as coloured dots. size is the dot width in metres; beyond two million points it is decimated.
Another saved drawing referenced in place: its records are fetched once and built as parts of this one block. Set pid to the id of the drawing to link.
